title: Kissed Sweet Peruvian Rice Onigiri
description: A sweet and dense Peruvian dish featuring branston pickle, shaped into nigiri and cooked in a banana leaf, following ayurvedic sattvic friendly principles.
instructions: Prepare the banana leaves by washing and cutting them into squares.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped branston pickle and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the turmeric and salt, and stir well.
Add the peruvian rice and water to the pan, and stir fry for 5 minutes.
Divide the rice mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a triangle.
Wrap each triangle in a banana leaf and steam for 10 minutes.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve hot.
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
